Article Title: NEET has flaw in design, it is not necessary: DMK's Dayanidhi Maran
Article Text:
File photo: DMK MP Dayanidhi Maran

NEW DELHI: DMK Tuesday demanded that NEET be scrapped as its MP Dayanidhi Maran in Lok Sabha asserted that the proposed amendment in the law against paper leak accused does not address the core problem bedeviling the medical entrance examination."You are not addressing the core issue. NEET is not necessary. DMK and Tamil Nadu were the first to voice their opposition to NEET due to the fundamental flaws in its design. Our warnings were never heard," he said, reiterating his party's stand against the national exam, which replaced state-level entrance tests.No longer part of the opposition INDIA bloc, Maran focused largely on his party's stand against NEET, the entrance exam to medical colleges, while tangentially referring to the recent student protest, the focus of BJP's opponents. Students have compelled parliamentarians to debate NEET, he saidHe alleged that Meta smart glasses had been used to record protesting students, following which police reached their homes. BJP grew on the back of protests, he said, asking the party as to why it was "opposed" to them.BJP is keen on getting support from DMK to push a constitution amend bill rolling out women's reservation from 2029 and raise the number of seats in Lok Sabha by over 50%.Maran claimed he and NCP - SP MP Supriya Sule were unable to use WhatsApp broadcasts for three days because of forwarding limits. "Today by mistake a Facebook post by the PM was removed, and the government called Meta chief to explain. But this is happening to MPs," Maran claimed.
Article Summary: DMK demands that NEET be scrapped as its MP Dayanidhi Maran in Lok Sabha. Maran claims proposed amendment in law against paper leak accused does not address the core problem bedeviling medical entrance examination. DMK and Tamil Nadu were the first to voice their opposition to NEET due to the fundamental flaws in its design.

Article Title: Delulu opposition thinks youth are with it, Rahul suffering from FOMO: NDA
Article Text:
File photo: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and BJP MP Tejasvi Surya

NEW DELHI: BJP and its allies Tuesday lauded govt's engagement with protesting students, asserted the youth believe in PM Narendra Modi's ability to root out the menace of paper leaks and turned to Gen Z's lingo to mock leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi as they mounted a sharp counterattack on the opposition in Lok Sabha."I will tell you in Gen Z language. Because of this issue (protest), opposition thinks the youth are with them. There is no bigger 'delulu' than it. Gen Z knows if any govt is working, then it is Modi govt," BJP MP Tejasvi Surya said, accusing rivals of spreading cynicism and anarchy, while Modi has used the crisis to launch root-and-branch reforms in the education system.Another party MP Anurag Thakur hit out at opposition parties for using students for their political gains and cited numerous incidents of paper leaks when they were in office in different states. When SP was in office in UP, the state service commission served the interest of one caste, and its chairperson Anil Yadav's appointment was struck down by HC, he said, amid noisy protest by SP members.Thakur's attack followed govt's robust defence from another party MP Bansuri Swaraj, who was the first speaker from the alliance, as she accused the opposition of "selective outrage" over paper leaks, saying such incidents frequently happened during the Congress-led UPA's term in office.Amid opposition's jibes, she said it was not about whataboutery but calling out the opposition. Targeting Congress, NDA members were prompt in sympathising with the concerns expressed by protesting students, asserting govt has heard them and offering suggestions to govt.Shiv Sena's Shrikant Shinde targeted Rahul over his protests, saying he sat on a dharna outside Modi's residence as he thought he was "MIA" (missing in action) and suffered from 'FOMO' (fear of missing out), but no student joined his demonstration.TDP's Lavu Sri Krishna Devarayalu suggested govt reform the burgeoning coaching system, suggesting it preyed on students' aspirations. Its market is around Rs 56,000 crore and will zoom to Rs 1 lakh crore in 6-7 years, he said, adding education should not be profit-driven, a point backed by Shinde too.Alleging that opposition sent anti-social elements to the student protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar who used filthy language and abuses for Modi, the Shiv Sena member said the engagement with protesters underscored govt's democratic commitment."We did not confine ourselves to condemnation but took up the task of cleaning the system. Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on moral grounds and not because of you (opposition)," he said, praising a series of measures taken by govt to reform the examination system.
Article Summary: BJP and its allies lauded govt's engagement with protesting students. They asserted the youth believe in PM Narendra Modi's ability to root out the menace of paper leaks. They turned to Gen Z's lingo to mock leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi.

Article Title: Congress, BJP spar over Pralhad Joshi's pick as education minister
Article Text:
BJP says the charge is baseless

NEW DELHI: Congress and BJP sparred over the choice of Union minister Pralhad Joshi being given the charge of the education ministry , with leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi accusing him of defending rapists and BJP's chief spokesperson Anil Baluni hitting back by accusing Rahul of distorting facts for an individual's character assassination.Rahul alleged that Joshi had, in a TV interview a few years ago, justified the release of those convicted of the gang rape of Bilkis Bano during the 2002 Gujarat riots, and dubbed the Union minister a "filthy man".The charge, made after Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla had expunged remarks by Rahul's sister, Wayanad MP and Congress general secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, drew a fierce response from Baluni, "This is unfortunate, deplorable and unacceptable."Accusing Rahul of making "misleading and factually incorrect" statements about Joshi's TV interview, the Pauri Garhwal MP said, "Joshi never tried to defend anybody. He was commenting on the process of remission and made no comment on the merits of the case."Speaking to reporters outside Parliament, Rahul said, "After all these young people protesting about the education system and so many girls protesting and being beaten and thrashed, BJP has given the charge of the ministry to a man who is a defender of rapists.There can be no filthier man than somebody who says rapists need protection. That is the education minister of India today."He added, "It is strange. It's a strange reaction from the Prime Minister. There are so many people in his cabinet. He could have chosen any one of them. But he chooses a person who protects rapists. It's quite amazing."Coming down hard on the Gandhi siblings, Baluni, head of BJP media cell, said the two should try to get their facts right and understand them. "They twist facts to suit what is convenient for them. They always make baseless charges to mislead people," he said.
Article Summary: Congress and BJP spar over choice of Union minister Pralhad Joshi. Rahul Gandhi accuses Joshi of defending rapists. BJP's chief spokesperson Anil Baluni hits back by accusing Rahul of distorting facts for an individual's character assassination. Rahul: Joshi justified release of those convicted of gang rape in 2002 Gujarat riots.

Article Title: After stalemate, government, opposition spar over paper leak law in Lok Sabha
Article Text:
File photo: Lok Sabha proceedings underway during the Monsoon Session of Parliament

Don’t view paper leaks through political lens, says Jitendra Singh

NEW DELHI: The week-long washout of Lok Sabha proceedings gave way to a fiery debate on Tuesday over the bill to make punitive measures more stringent and trial speedier in paper leak cases, as opposition members backed the students’ protests and criticised police’s alleged excesses against the protestors.Speakers from the BJP-led NDA brought up incidents of paper leaks during the UPA’s term and in states governed by opposition parties to emphasise that the menace had persisted irrespective of the party in office, and asserted that the country’s youth believed in PM Narendra Modi’s ability to usher in reforms to end it.Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra said Modi must take responsibility for the “injustice” with the youth, and he and home minister Amit Shah should answer as to who authorised the “use” of pellet guns on protestors in Delhi and an AK-47, which relates to an incident in Bihar with state police saying the gun was fired in the air in self-defence, in handling the agitation.Speakers from BJP and its allies acknowledged the concerns of students, and said the fact that govt engaged with them and had come out with a slew of measures underscored its democratic spirit. Students did not join Rahul Gandhi’s protest, some of them pointed out.Speaking on the Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill as the debate began a little after 2pm, Union minister Jitendra Singh said the “malaise” of paper leaks had affected state-level and national exams irrespective of the party in office and lauded the proposed law as a reaffirmation of govt’s commitment to safeguard students’ welfare.“Government’s intentions are honest and the amendment has been brought with an honest attitude. No member of any party should have any objection to it and if they have, then people will have objections to them,” he said.The minister of state in the PMO said govt had learnt from experience as any responsible govt should, emphasising the more stringent punishment proposed against individuals, organised gangs and entities involved in any paper leak, coupled with provisions for speedy justice.BJP MP Anurag Thakur said paper leak was no less a danger than terrorism and Maoism, as it targeted the youth first. “I want to tell the youth of the country that we will fully cure this disease of paper leaks because Modi govt has given us medicine for all diseases so far,” he said.Amid criticism of NTA, which organises several pan-India competitive exams, including NEET, Singh said back in 1992, a recommendation was first made to govt that there should be a common national testing agency.“Then, in 2010, during UPA govt, there was again a committee which suggested this. I do not know why this was not given due consideration. You must compliment PM Modi and this govt. It has finished an unfinished task which you should have accomplished,” he said.Citing recent paper leaks in Punjab and Karnataka, where AAP and Congress are in office, respectively, besides several other states where opposition parties have held office, Singh stressed that paper leaks should not be seen through a political lens.
Article Summary: Speakers from the BJP-led NDA brought up incidents of paper leaks during the UPA’s term and in states governed by opposition parties to emphasise that the menace had persisted. Union minister Jitendra Singh: Paper leaks should not be seen through a political lens. “I want to tell the youth of the country that we will fully cure this disease,” he said.

Article Title: CBI files chargesheet against 13 accused in NEET-UG paper leak case; hearing tomorrow
Article Text: NEW DELHI: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on Tuesday filed a chargesheet against 13 accused in connection with the NEET-UG paper leak case before the Rouse Avenue Court in Delhi.The chargesheet, filed by the Economic Offences Wing of the CBI, will be placed before the special fast-track court constituted to hear paper leak cases on Wednesday.According to the agency, the case has been registered under Sections 315(5), 318(4), 61(2), 238 and 303(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, along with Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(a) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, and Sections 3, 4, 5, 10 and 11 of the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024.As per the information shared by ANI, the accused named in the chargesheet are Yash Yadav, Mangilal Biwal, Dinesh Biwal, Vikas Biwal, Subham Khairnar, Dhananjay Lokhande, Prahalad Kulkarni, Tejas Harshad Kumar, Dr Manoj Shirure, Shivraj Raghunath Motegaonkar, Manisha Waghmare, Manisha Mandhare, and Manisha Sanjay Hawaldar.All 13 accused are currently in judicial custody.The alleged leak of the NEET-UG examination paper triggered nationwide outrage and led to multiple investigations into irregularities in the conduct of the medical entrance examination.Dharmendra Pradhan also resigned on July 25 as Union education minister, following which the Cockroach Janta Party withdrew its 36-day agitation that had mobilised lakhs of people over alleged irregularities in competitive examinations and the NEET paper leak.
Article Summary: The chargesheet, filed by the Economic Offences Wing of the CBI, will be placed before the special fast-track court constituted to hear paper leak cases on Wednesday. The alleged leak of the NEET-UG examination paper triggered nationwide outrage and led to multiple investigations into irregularities.

Article Title: 'Kidnapped, questioned, abandoned': Man who disturbed food during CJP protest at Jantar Mantar moves Supreme Court
Article Text:
Junaid Malik, who distributed food at CJP protest site at Jantar Mantar, Tuesday moved Supreme Court accusing Delhi Police of kidnapping him.





NEW DELHI: Junaid Malik, who distributed food at CJP protest site at Jantar Mantar, Tuesday moved Supreme Court accusing Delhi Police of kidnapping him, questioning him about funds for food supply and then abandoning him near Dehradun. He also alleged that UP Police harassed his family members because of the support he had lent to the agitation.Appearing for Junaid, advocate Prashant Bhushan told a bench led by CJI Surya Kant that while the agitation was continuing, UP Police had pressured his family members to persuade him to refrain from participating in the protest, return home and appear before police to disclose the source of funds for the food he supplied to protestors.“Questioning and coercive actions against the family members were carried out, inter alia, by DSP (Rural), Ghaziabad, ASP Masuri, SHO Masuri and two Intelligence Bureau officers from Delhi, who also questioned family members of applicant’s married sister,” he alleged through advocate-on-record Neha Rathi.“Such conduct can’t be justified as a legitimate exercise of police power and warrants strict judicial scrutiny to ensure that machinery of the State is not employed as an instrument of intimidation, coercion or retaliation against persons exercising their fundamental rights,” he said.
Article Summary: Junaid Malik, who distributed food at CJP protest site at Jantar Mantar, Tuesday moved Supreme Court accusing Delhi Police of kidnapping him. He also alleged that UP Police harassed his family members because of the support he had lent to the agitation.

Article Title: Congress stages rasta roko in Kalyan over police action on Jantar Mantar protesters
Article Text:
Congress workers staged a protest in Kalyan West against alleged police action.





KALYAN: Congress workers staged a rasta roko protest at Shivaji Chowk in Kalyan West to protest against the alleged police action on students demonstrating at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi over the alleged paper leak issue.Led by Navin Singh, Kalyan District President, the protesters raised slogans against the Centre and demanded action over the alleged assault on students and peaceful demonstrators by the Delhi Police.Traffic was briefly affected in the area before police intervened.The party also submitted a memorandum to the Kalyan tehsildar, addressed to the President of India, seeking an inquiry into the alleged police action against students and Congress leaders, including Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi, MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other party leaders, during the protest at Delhi.In the memorandum, the Congress demanded the immediate resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, holding him morally responsible for the alleged irregularities in the paper leak. The party also sought an urgent discussion in Parliament on alleged examination irregularities and issues affecting students' future.The memorandum further demanded that all FIRs and criminal cases registered against students and peaceful protesters be withdrawn immediately.Among those present at the protest were corporator Samina Sheikh, former corporator Iftekar Khan and other Congress office-bearers and workers. Police maintained security at the protest site and ensured traffic movement was restored after the demonstration concluded.
Article Summary: Congress workers staged a rasta roko protest at Shivaji Chowk in Kalyan West. They were protesting against the alleged police action on students demonstrating at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. The protesters raised slogans against the Centre and demanded action over the alleged assault on students and peaceful demonstrators.

Article Title: Jantar Mantar violence echoes in KDMC house meet as opposition, MNS protest police action
Article Text:
As soon as the proceedings began, opposition members stood up, shouted slogans and disrupted the House.





KALYAN: The Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation (KDMC) General Body meeting on Thursday witnessed high drama as opposition corporators staged a protest against the alleged police action against students demonstrating at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.Corporators from the opposition, including the Shiv Sena (UBT), Congress and NCP (SP), entered the House carrying the Tricolour and wearing black armbands as a mark of protest. Raising slogans of "Bharat Mata Ki Jai" and "Vande Mataram", they demanded that the House be adjourned to condemn the police action and express solidarity with the injured protesters.As soon as the proceedings began, opposition members stood up, shouted slogans and disrupted the House, forcing Mayor Harshali Chaudhary to adjourn the meeting for 10 minutes.However, after the House reconvened, the opposition continued its protest, condemning what it termed police brutality at Jantar Mantar and urging corporators from the ruling alliance to join them.The protest also witnessed an unusual political alignment, with the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS), a ruling ally of the Shiv Sena in the KDMC, joining hands with the Shiv Sena (UBT) during the demonstration. The BJP took a swipe at the MNS, saying that if MNS corporators wished to sit with the opposition, they should first resign from the ruling alliance and formally move to the opposition benches.Differences within the ruling alliance also came to the fore during the debate. Shiv Sena corporator Mahesh Gaikwad demanded that the House observe a two-minute silence in memory of the students who were allegedly injured in the police action. BJP group leader Shashikant Kamble objected, stating that several police personnel were also injured during the Jantar Mantar protest and that, if a condolence gesture was to be made, it should include them as well.Despite the noisy scenes and repeated slogan-shouting, the General Body meeting continued. Later, leaders of the Shiv Sena and BJP jointly cleared several civic proposals without detailed discussion, while a few agenda items were deferred for consideration at a later meeting.
Article Summary: Corporators from the opposition, including the Shiv Sena (UBT), Congress and NCP (SP), entered the House carrying the Tricolour and wearing black armbands as a mark of protest. Raising slogans of "Bharat Mata Ki Jai" and "Vande Mataram", they demanded that the House be adjourned.

Article Title: Two Pune rural police personnel suspended in Rs1 crore robbery attempt case
Article Text:
The Narhe police said both the suspended constables are currently on the run, and efforts are on to trace them

Pune:





Two personnel attached to an outpost of the Rajgad police station were suspended by the Pune Rural police on Tuesday after they were booked by the Narhe police for an alleged attempt to rob Rs1 crore.“We have suspended two personnel posted at the Rajgad police station outpost after the Narhe police booked them in a robbery case. We are also conducting a departmental inquiry against them,” said superintendent of police (Pune Rural) Sandeep Singh Gill.“We initiated an inquiry as soon as we learnt of the cash transaction at the outpost. We decided to suspend them once the Narhe police established their role in the robbery and booked them as suspects,” he said.The Narhe police said both the suspended constables are currently on the run, and efforts are on to trace them.Earlier, police arrested four individuals in connection with the case: Vikram Vilas Chakankar (44), Amey Arvind Karle (46), Ganesh Ramesh Kadam (33), and reporter Ashish Tiwari (39). According to investigators, Tiwari allegedly siphoned off Rs20 lakh from the Rs1 crore kept at the police outpost on the Pune-Satara Highway while the cash was being handled by the two suspended personnel.The robbery attempt was reportedly foiled when a senior police officer arrived at the outpost unexpectedly, causing the suspects to panic.The case was registered following a complaint by a stationery businessman from Talegaon Dabhade. He alleged that the accused, posing as police personnel, intercepted him near Navale Bridge and attempted to rob him of Rs1 crore before forcibly taking him to the outpost and seizing the cash.
Article Summary: Two personnel attached to an outpost of the Rajgad police station were suspended by the Pune Rural police on Tuesday. They were booked by the Narhe police for an alleged attempt to rob Rs1 crore. The robbery attempt was reportedly foiled when a senior police officer arrived at the outpost unexpectedly.

Article Title: Five rivals booked for chasing police vans escorting Andekar gang members
Article Text:
An AI-generated illustration of motorcyclists pursuing a police van

Pune:





The members of the Suraj Thombre (ST)-gang chased police vans escorting members of the Andekar gang, accused of the murders of Ayush Komkar and Ganesh Kale, twice on July 23 and 28, leading to fresh trouble between the two groups.Crime branch officials on Monday lodged a complaint against five members of the ST gang with the Bharati Vidyapeeth police. The police then registered a case about the alleged chase and related incidents in the Katraj Ghat section.The officials suspected that the ST gang members conspired to eliminate gangster Krishna Andekar and his relatives while they were being escorted by police from the court to prisons in connection with a case registered under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA).Following the murder of Vanraj Andekar, members of the Andekar gang allegedly retaliated by killing Komkar and Kale. Recently, Akshay Mhaske survived a third murder attempt in Sahakarnagar.Police believed that the Andekar gang had continued to orchestrate retaliatory attacks despite many of its members being behind bars. Last week, the accused were being escorted from the Shivajinagar court to prisons in Nandurbar and Dhule districts in police vans.However, the ST gang members allegedly chased the convoy on a motorcycle up to Chakan. The escort officials realised they were being followed and raised an alarm when the motorcycle riders attempted to intercept the police van.According to investigators, the suspects were allegedly providing real-time information about the convoy, including the number of police vehicles and its location. Police also suspected that the two men were carrying firearms.
Article Summary: Members of the Suraj Thombre (ST)-gang chased police vans escorting members of the Andekar gang, accused of the murders of Ayush Komkar and Ganesh Kale, twice on July 23 and 28. Crime branch officials on Monday lodged a complaint against five members ofthe ST gang.

Article Title: Educationist and BJP functionary arrested in fake Shalarth ID case
Article Text:
A team of Nashik police tak educationist Sanjay Garud into custody from a farmhouse in a village in Solapur district on Monday.

Nashik:





The city police on Monday arrested a well-known educationist from Jalgaon in the fake Shalarth ID case on Monday.The accused has been identified as Sanjay Garud, who is a also a BJP functionary and resident of Shendurni in Jamner taluka of Jalgaon district. This marks the sixth arrest in the case registered with the Nashik Road police station in March this year.An officer from the Nashik city police said 67-year-old Garud was evading arrest. “On Monday, he was arrested from a farmhouse in Natepute in Solapur district in connection with the case registered on March 12, 2026, for offences punishable under Sections 318(4) (Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property), 316(2) (criminal breach of trust), 316(5) (covering specific breach of trust), 336(2)(3) (forgery of documents or electronic record) and 61(2) (criminal conspiracy to commit serious offence) among other sections of the BNS and the Information Technology (IT) Act, 2000. ”ACP (crime) Sandeep Mitke said the scam involves systematic embezzlement of govt funds amounting to Rs160 crore under the jurisdiction of deputy director of education (Nashik division), covering Nashik, Jalgaon, Dhule and Nandurbar districts.He said a total of 841 teaching and non-teaching staff members were illegally included into the official ‘Shalarth’ salary system. Without submitting the mandatory individual approval proposals to the education department, the accused forged backdated appointment orders and drafted fraudulent entries into the payroll software to siphon off monthly salaries and arrear payments.So far, around 1,200 individuals, including school principals, trust operators, former deputy directors of education, education officers and pay superintendents, have been identified as suspects.Sanjay Garud operates 15 school institutions. The investigation by the Special Investigation Team (SIT) headed by Mitke has found that fake individual approvals were issued for 177 staff members across his schools, even though no valid approval proposals were ever received or processed by the education officer’s department.Following confidential intelligence and precise technical tracking, the Nashik crime branch discovered that Garud was taking refuge at a farmhouse in Solapur. Under the guidance of Mitke, a specialised team comprising sub-inspector Chetan Shrivant and officers Pravin Waghmare, Mahesh Salunkhe, Uttam Pawar, Milindsingh Pardeshi and Nazim Khan Pathan raided the location.On being asked about the arrest, water resources minister Girish Mahajan said he was taking information about the same.
Article Summary: The accused has been identified as Sanjay Garud, a also a BJP functionary and resident of Shendurni in Jamner taluka of Jalgaon district. This marks the sixth arrest in the case registered with the Nashik Road police station in March this year.

Article Title: DVAC raids residences of former DMK minister Senthil Balaji, aides in Tamil Nadu's Karur
Article Text: KARUR: DVAC on Wednesday morning began conducting raids at former DMK minister V Senthil Balaji's residence in Karur and at locations associated with his close confidantes.Sources said the raids began at around 7am.The searches are going on at the former minister's residence in Rameshwarapatti; the Murthipalayam residence of Senthil Balaji's assistant, Subramani; the Koyampalli residence of DMK Karur east union secretary Bhaskar; and the residences of Karthik and Ramesh in Kothai Nagar.The raids are also being conducted at Tasmac district office at Thozhilpettai in Karur.Recently, Senthil Balaji, his brother Ashok Kumar, Karthik, and Ramesh were all alleged by the police to have been involved in a case involving an attempt to poach TVK MLA N Ilaiyaraja by offering Rs 35 crores.Triplicane police have so far arrested 14 persons in the case and suspect that Senthil Balaji and Ashok Kumar were part of the alleged conspiracy to topple the TVK govt.
Article Summary: Sources said the raids began at around 7am. Senthil Balaji, his brother Ashok Kumar, Karthik, and Ramesh were all alleged by the police to have been involved in a case involving an attempt to poach TVK MLA N Ilaiyaraja.

Article Title: Sengottaiyan flays previous DMK govt for not having pursued legal remedies on Mekedatu dam issue
Article Text:
K A Sengottaiyan





ERODE: Tamil Nadu revenue minister K A Sengottaiyan on Saturday criticized the previous DMK govt for not having pursued legal remedies to stop Karnataka’s move to build a dam across the Cauvery river in Mekedatu.Speaking at a consultation meeting of officials from different departments held at the Erode district collectorate, Sengottaiyan reiterated that chief minister C Joseph Vijay had urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to halt the move to build a dam in Mekedatu.During the review meeting, the minister told officials to deliver results quickly, saying the govt’s performance since coming to power warranted a thorough review and that the people’s demands should be met without delay. “Officers must complete necessary office procedures promptly and ensure citizens receive timely relief,” he told reporters after the meeting.The review, chaired by district collector S Kandasamy and also attended by handloom minister M Vijay Balaji, covered a wide range of administrative concerns.A major focus was the Athikadavu-Avinashi integrated drinking water project. Officials were directed to find out why more than 70 ponds were not getting filled and asked them to take remedial measures. Officials were instructed to begin silt-removal operations in the Bhavanisagar Dam to improve storage capacity and downstream supply.On allegations that liquor outlets were operating in violation of regulations, the revenue minister demanded concrete statistics and warned that strict action would follow where breaches were confirmed.
Article Summary: K A Sengottaiyan criticized the previous DMK govt for not having pursued legal remedies to stop Karnataka’s move to build a dam across the Cauvery river in Mekedatu. He reiterated that chief minister C Joseph Vijay had urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to halt the move.

Article Title: Palani Mutt temple land case: CB-CID arrests 3 over Rs 100 crore property fraud
Article Text: DINDIGUL: The CB-CID has arrested three persons on Wednesday morning in connection with the case pertaining to fraudulent registration of the 1.4-acre land valued at Rs 100 crore, belonging to the Arulmigu Dhandapani Swamigal Madam in Palani in Dindigul district.The arrested were identified as Murugadas, 56, of Villupuram, who allegedly sold the land using forged documents; Vellaithurai,60, of Tiruppur, who allegedly purchased the property; and advocate Anwardeen,65, of Palani, who is suspected to have facilitated the transaction.Cases have been registered against them under sections 318(4), 336(3), 340(2), 49 and 61(2) of BNS..The case pertains to the alleged fraudulent registration of mutt land, valued at around Rs 100 crore through fabricated records.Following a complaint lodged by Muruganandam, superintendent of the Palani temple lands division, the Palani Adivaram police had initially registered a case against former sub-registrar Justin Manikandan, trust functionary Murugadas, purchaser Vellaithurai and Sethupathi of Palani Pudur under various charges, including cheating and criminal conspiracy.The Tamil Nadu government transferred the investigation to the CB-CID on July 15.A special team led by CB-CID SP B H Sajitha and DSP Ajay Thangam has since been conducting an extensive inquiry in Dindigul and Palani.More than 15 persons, including former temple joint commissioner Marimuthu, retired tahsildar Mariyappan, retired village administrative officer Chinnasamy, and HR&CE inspector Sivanesan, have been questioned.
Article Summary: The case pertains to the alleged fraudulent registration of mutt land, valued at around Rs 100 crore through fabricated records. More than 15 persons, including former temple joint commissioner Marimuthu, retired tahsildar Mariyappan, retired village administrative officer Chinnasamy, and HR&CE inspector Sivanesan have been questioned.

Article Title: Fireman dies by suicide alleging harassment by loan sharks in Madurai; one arrested
Article Text:
Madurai

:





Police arrested a man in connection with the alleged abetment of suicide of a fire and rescue services personnel who was found hanging at his house in Usilampatti in Madurai district on Saturday.The deceased, identified as Sureshkumar, a resident of Sathya Nagar in Usilampatti, was serving as a fireman at the Guindy Fire and Rescue Services Station in Chennai. He came to his native place on leave when he allegedly died by suicide at his residence.According to police sources, before taking the extreme step, Sureshkumar recorded and released a video stating that he had borrowed more than Rs5 lakh on interest and was facing persistent harassment from lenders.Based on the contents of the video and subsequent investigation, Usilampatti Town Police registered a case and arrested Praveenkumar, from Nalliveeranpatti, on Monday, who is alleged to have lent money to the deceased.Police have registered a case against Praveenkumar under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).Further investigation is under way to ascertain the circumstances that led to Sureshkumar's death and whether others were involved in the alleged harassment.(Assistance for those having suicidal thoughts is available on TN’s health helpline 104 and Sneha’s suicide prevention helpline 044-24640050)
Article Summary: The deceased, identified as Sureshkumar, was serving as a fireman at the Guindy Fire and Rescue Services Station in Chennai. He came to his native place on leave when he allegedly died by suicide at his residence. Police have registered a case against Praveenkumar under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

Article Title: Two held for employing guest workers against their will at agro firm near Madurai
Article Text:
Two held for employing guest workers against their will at agro firm near Madurai

Madurai

:





Two people, including the proprietor and manager of a private agro-products company near Vadipatti at Madurai, were booked after labour department officials found nine guest workers, including four adolescents, working at the unit without sufficient wages.Labour department officials said that they received complaints from Bihar regarding guest workers being employed with low wages.Subsequently, the labour department officials conducted a raid at a private agro-firm, located at Nagari in Thaniciyam near Vadipatti, on the night of July 23. Officials found nine workers employed against their will.They were employed for loading and unloading the stocks within the firm, while the adolescent workers were employed for simple work, a labour department official said.Further, they were at the govt home, and the labour department is in the process of sending them back to Bihar.A case was registered at Vadipatti police station under sections 146 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and 79 of the Juvenile Justice Act following a complaint filed by the department of industrial safety and health.The complaint was lodged by T Sudhakar, deputy director of Industrial Safety and Health, Madurai.
Article Summary: Two people, including the proprietor and manager of a private agro-products company near Vadipatti at Madurai, were booked. Officials found nine guest workers, including four adolescents, working at the unit without sufficient wages. The labour department is in the process of sending them back to Bihar.

She complained that no action was taken against the teacher despite complaints being lodged with the police. Further investigation is under way.

Article Title: Move to encroach upon Thattakkattupuzha River foiled
Article Text:
Kochi

:





The attempt to encroach upon Thattakkattupuzha River near Poonithura Gandhi Square mini bypass was blocked by locals and people’s representatives on Tuesday. They lodged a complaint with the district collector and police, thereby forcing the private firm, which encroached on the river, to backtrack.According to corporation councillor V P Chandran, the attempt to drive concrete pillars into the river and fill it was stopped by the village officials. “The private firm removed the pillars. Encroachments are fast shrinking the waterbodies in the city, and they cause waterlogging as well as spreading of communicable diseases,” Chandran said.The private firm owns a holding adjacent to the river, and it had already levelled the land.
